transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, what brings me in is that I just feel like I can't settle in my own body anymore. It's really noticeable when I'm supposed to sit quietly and handle things like paperwork or going over household plans. I just can't seem to stay still or focus.
Have you experienced these difficulties with sitting still and focusing since you were a child, or is this a relatively new development for you?

No, it's definitely not new. Looking back, I realize this was already part of me back in elementary school. I was always the girl with a completely messy desk, and I was constantly forgetting my permission slips. My parents would get notes from my teachers saying I talked out of turn, or that I just seemed unable to stay seated during class. So, yeah, it's been going on since I was a child.
